subject: Post‑discovery: lock demo date + security & procurement points
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Post‑discovery: lock demo date + security & procurement points

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time earlier — really helpful to walk through the FinLytics ingestion and governance priorities. Quick recap and two asks so we can get the demo scheduled and the right stakeholders looped in: 

Recap (high level):
- Main goal: surface pretrained model answers for compliance use cases (SLA: sub-250ms for 98th pct traffic).
- Security must review network flow and data retention; procurement will want an outline of licensing and an estimated monthly run rate.

Asks: 
1) Can we lock a 60‑minute technical demo next week? Suggested windows below.
2) Please introduce your security owner and procurement contact so we can send a brief prep packet (security checklist + agenda + draft SOW).

Suggested demo windows (PST):
- Tue 2027‑11‑28: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2027‑11‑29: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

Planned attendees from Redwood: me (solutions), Marissa (sales engineer) and Karthik (platform/infra). Marissa—i've attached a short demo agenda draft; please review and flag any extra technical hooks.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-2027-11-28.pdf (agenda draft), FinLytics_Security_Contacts.pdf (request template)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@finlytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery: lock demo date + security & procurement points

Thanks, Sean — great recap. We want the demo to include: SSO/SCIM flow, data-at-rest encryption, and a quick cost-per-embedding estimate for our volume.

I'm looping in our security lead, Arjun Patel (arjun.patel@finlytics.com), and procurement (procure@finlytics.com). Arjun — quick note: Sean will send the security checklist; could you review and let us know any blocking items before the demo?

For timing, the Wed 11/29 09:00–10:00 PST works best for our engineering and security folks. If Redwood can take that slot, we'll lock it.

Elena Díaz
Head of Data Products, FinLytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@finlytics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 08:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery: lock demo date + security & procurement points

Thanks Elena — locking Wed 11/29 09:00–10:00 PST on our side. I've updated the agenda to include an SSO/SCIM walkthrough and a short section on quantization/throughput tradeoffs for cost estimates.

Pre‑demo actions (small MLP):
- Redwood: provide brief answers to Arjun’s likely checklist items (network, retention, logs) + a short cost model for expected QPS. (Owner: Karthik)
- FinLytics: share any sample request volumes (per day / peak) and your security questionnaire if you'd like us to prefill. (Owner: Elena)

Karthik — I've added you to the calendar invite. Karthik, quick note on owners: can you prepare a one‑pager on KV cache and batching impact on latency for mixed small/large prompts? That will help Arjun see tradeoffs.

I attached the updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-2027-11-28.pdf). Sean: i'll follow up with a calendar invite and separate doc with the security checklist link.

—Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@finlytics.com>

See you on Wednesday.
